summary: test_artifact_skill_explains_both_write_mechanisms asserts full-text equality of the real ARTIFACT_SKILL.instructions (fetched via TaskService.skills(), no mocks) against an independently-authored expected string containing all three conjuncts: 'An artifact is a durable task document that the user can review', 'Publish anything you want the user to review as an artifact, regardless of document type', and the GitHub-URL exception routed to the external URL field / p hotkey rather than the a-hotkey artifact list; dropping or inverting any clause breaks the exact match, so each boundary case is genuinely rejected.
